title: Animakind Binding Designation Record
description: Canonical record for a Unique Animakind Binding (UAB) designation: the pairing of a design with an engine, coined by the Studio. Source: the specification, Section 3 and Appendix A.

designation.description: UAB designation: [studio]_[family]-[mark]_v[build].[revision]_[strike date]. Studio, Family, a version and a Strike Date are required; Mark is optional; Strike Date is YYYYMMDD, and every advance mints a new one (Section 3.2). A Mark advance re-bases the designation, which restarts at v1.0. The Studio coins the Binding. The Family is the Binding Name; a change of it is a FAMILY_MIGRATION of the same subject, not a new individual. Only a divergence continued as a second line mints a new UII. Segments may be in any script; none is empty or contains whitespace, "_" or "-".

design.description: The Design axis. Mirrors the design designation [company]_[product line]-[product mark]_v[product version] (Section 3.1).

type.description: Design Type: the class of designed identity artifact. Open set; in this generation an Animagraph (Section 3.3). A change of Type advances the Mark.

studio.description: The organization that authored the design and coins the Binding. Same party the design designation names as Company.

product_line.description: Design lineage. Registered once, never altered.

product_mark.description: Optional design-side generation marker. Null when absent; a designation without one is well-formed.

product_version.description: Version of the design as released, v[major].[minor]; recorded here without the leading v, as in Appendix A.

engineering.description: The engine's own designation, recorded as its manufacturer publishes it. Must carry at minimum a Manufacturer, an engine identifier, and that manufacturer's version (Section 3.2). A field the manufacturer does not publish is marked absent (null), not guessed.

type.description: Engineering Type: class of computational system. Open set; at present a large language model (Section 3.3). A change of Type advances the Mark.

version.description: Manufacturer's own version string (Engine Version). A change advances the Revision.

supersedes.description: The UAB designation this one replaces. Null for the first designation of a lineage.

advancement.description: Which field advanced and why (Section 3.3, Table 4: Mark <- Design Type, Studio, Engineering Type, Manufacturer; Build <- a new engine from the same Manufacturer, major design change; Revision <- minor design change, Engine Version). A Mark advance takes precedence and re-bases the designation, which restarts at v1.0. Every advance mints a new designation with a new Strike Date. The Family never advances: a change of Family (the Binding Name) is a FAMILY_MIGRATION of the same subject, with the same UII and a whole-number UIV advance, and its new designation also starts at v1.0 (Table 5).

field.description: "family" records a FAMILY_MIGRATION: the Binding Name is replaced, not advanced, and the designation restarts at v1.0.

cause.description: The trigger, named from the advancement table. The paper's only worked value is "engine"; the remaining token spellings are not fixed by the paper.
